thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT — Okta /introspect errors seen from 10:32 UTC, high rate of 502/504s causing login failures and console auth errors

marta (oncall): saw a spike in 502s hitting our token-verifier service at ~10:31, doubling error rate. users reporting console lockouts. paging SRE.

samir: looking at logs now. `token-verifier` in us-east has 502s coming back from Okta introspect endpoints. same stacktrace: `upstream timed out` and `502 Bad Gateway`.

jess (sre-lead): impact? are API keys affected or just interactive logins?

kevin (eng): initial sampling: API calls that validate Okta tokens (console + web UI) are failing validation path. Internal service-to-service with signed tokens still ok. It's the introspect path and JWKS fetch intermittently failing.

marta (oncall): customer-facing: web console login failures / signup flows impacted. No evidence of token forgery. Traffic is routing to Okta us-east endpoints which show degraded health on status page.

okta-status-bot: Okta Status update: "Partial outage impacting Introspection & Token endpoints in US-EAST-1. Engineers investigating." https://status.okta.com/incidents/xyz-123

samir: reproducer curl against introspect endpoint:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://okta-us.example.com/oauth2/v1/introspect -d 'token=REDACTED'
* Connected to okta-us.example.com (99.84.76.18) port 443 (#0)
> POST /oauth2/v1/introspect HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"bad_gateway","error_description":"upstream error"}
```

marta (oncall): mitigation options I'm pushing now: 1) enable local JWKS cache fallback in token-verifier (already implemented but disabled) 2) increase timeouts + retry for introspect calls 3) route non-interactive validation to cached keys where safe.

jess (sre-lead): agree. prioritize (1) immediately. We need a quick feature flip non-breaking. Kevin can you flip JWKS fallback on prod?

kevin (eng): flipping in 30s — creating canary config for token-verifier-service: `ENABLE_JWKS_LOCAL_FALLBACK=true` and `INTROSPECT_RETRY=3` then restarting 3 pods in us-east canary group.

incident-bot: deploy-bot started rollout: `token-verifier v2.3.1 -> with jwks-fallback` on us-east-canary (3 pods).

marta (oncall): will monitor errors. also notifying support to prepare customer comms.

samir: after flip, initial canary logs show introspect 502s persist but fallback JWKS validated ~80% of previously failing requests (cached tokens). error rate down by ~60% on canary.

jess (sre-lead): good. escalate to full us-east once canary stable 5m. also open a support ticket with Okta: include logs, timestamps, region. Samir, please paste request ids.

samir: Okta ticket opened: INC-0009876. included `x-request-id` samples and timestamps. They acknowledged.

hid: (system) note: some customers will still see failure for freshly issued tokens that require introspect. We should classify impact: "Console login failures for new sessions; existing sessions largely unaffected where cached JWKS used."

marta (oncall): Customer impact assessment summary for ops-sig: 
- Affected: Interactive console logins and OAuth introspection flows created in last ~5 minutes
- Not affected: Internal service tokens signed and cached, existing sessions validated via JWKS cache
- Approximate % of web logins impacted: ~18% at peak in us-east

kevin (eng): rolling to full us-east now (gradual): increasing replica restarts with jwks-fallback enabled across clusters.

incident-bot: deploy-bot completed rollout to us-east.

samir: monitoring shows global error rate dropped to baseline within 8 minutes post-rollout. Some residual 502s but within SLOs.

jess (sre-lead): okta support says investigating on their side; they think it's a proxy layer in front of token endpoints. They've opened an RFO internally.

marta (oncall): handoff incoming: I'll be off at 12:00 UTC, handing to @jess for follow-up. Oncall-handoff-bot: Handoff created for 12:00 UTC to jess (sre-lead).

jess (sre-lead): taking over. next steps: 1) confirm post-incident remediation with Okta 2) schedule postmortem to capture decision to enable JWKS fallback as pre-approved mitigation 3) add longer-term change: consider tiered fallback for freshly issued tokens and a short-lived grace window.

kevin (eng): PR opened to keep JWKS fallback as configurable flag with safer semantics and metrics: https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-verifier/pull/412

marta (oncall): final status update to slack: "Incident resolved to degraded state. Workarounds in place (JWKS fallback). Okta investigating root cause. No data exposure. Postmortem will follow." :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — degraded service, mitigation applied. Incident record: INC-2026-03-15-okta-introspect-1942003333

jess (sre-lead): we'll run a full RCA and include recommended config changes and operational runbook updates. Thanks all for quick response.

oncall-handoff-bot: Handoff complete. 

marta (oncall): closing thread; will add timeline to postmortem doc. :coffee:
